title: introduce-transient-affordance-tags-and-cost-aware-release-autosummarizer
author: Priya Sharma
release_notes: Add transient affordance tags for onboarding and per-variant cost allocation metadata; introduce an automated release-note summarizer that drafts curator-first summaries from profile deltas; no breaking changes.
description: Context: customers and platform teams have asked for cheaper ways to tag incoming model variants with ephemeral affordance hints (used for onboarding, A/B sampling and canary routing) and to attach lightweight cost-allocation metadata so billing/commit teams can see estimated inference impact per-variant. We also need better first-draft release notes for model profile rollouts so reviewers can focus on verification instead of writing prose. This PR implements: 1) Transient 'affordance' tags: schema-driven, TTL-backed tags attached at variant intake. They are not part of the canonical profile stamp and expire automatically, but are surfaced in onboarding UIs and the probe sampler. 2) Per-variant cost_allocation metadata: optional numeric weight and owner identifiers that flow through the profile, used by telemetry exporters and chargeback reports. 3) Release autosummarizer: a tool that consumes profile delta events and generates a human-curation draft containing concise impact bullets (latency/cost delta, stability flags, affected endpoints, suggested rollback thresholds). It uses deterministic templates + heuristic highlights from perf signatures; curators can accept/edit before publish. 4) Migration hooks & guards: an onboarding middleware validates TTLs and cost weights; rollout prevents attaching cost_allocation to archived variants. 5) Tests and docs: unit tests for tagging TTLs and summarizer heuristics, and a new doc: docs/onboarding/affordance-and-cost-tags.md. Motivation: reduce manual bookkeeping for fast model intake and make release notes consistent and actionable. Checklist: - [x] schema for transient_tag and cost_allocation - [x] TTL engine and index cleanup job - [x] autosummarizer CLI and server-side composer - [x] telemetry export for per-variant cost weight - [x] docs + migration notes - [x] unit/integration tests - [x] security review for metadata fields Security and compatibility: transient tags are opt-in at intake and explicitly excluded from canonical profile hashes to avoid sign/verification issues. cost_allocation is optional and limited to a predefined set of owner identifiers; a lint rule prevents free-form owners. Backward compatibility: existing profiles remain unchanged; the defaults are opt-out. Operational notes: index cleanup job runs hourly and reclaims expired transient tags; the autosummarizer is rate-limited and logs drafts under /internal/release-drafts for curator review. Linear references: ENG-1342 (affordance tags), ENG-1408 (release autosummarizer). This description is intentionally prose-dense to provide reviewers and oncall engineers the whole context in one place.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial schema + migrations; TTL engine and cleanup job; autosummarizer core + templates; telemetry exporter + tests; docs and example curator edits. Key commits: 'schema: add transient_tag and cost_allocation', 'autosummary: add composer and CLI', 'cleanup: hourly expired-tag reclaim', 'tests: summarizer heuristics and tagging behavior', 'docs: onboarding affordance and cost tags'.
review_comments: 2026-02-20 Lina García: Can we guarantee transient tags do not affect profile hashes? - Answered: Priya: yes, they are stored in a separate metadata bucket and excluded from canonicalize() and signature flows.

2026-02-22 Ethan Moore: Autosummarizer sometimes overemphasized small lat deltas in synthetic probes — suggested thresholding. - Response: Priya: tightened heuristics and added a configurable threshold in composer config (defaults conservative).

2026-02-25 Omar Khan: Add a lint rule to forbid free-form owner strings in cost_allocation. - Response: Priya: added owner whitelist and a pre-commit hook; included migration to flag nonconforming values.
2026-02-27 Lina García (approval): Tests look solid and docs are clear; approve for merge once CI passes.

merge_details: Merged on 2026-03-03 via squash merge by Lina García. Merge commit: AB12CD347F. Post-merge actions: kicked off migration job (migrations/20260218_add_transient_tag.sql) and created release draft tag v0.18.3-registry; ops will monitor index-reclaim metrics for 24h.
notes_for_ops: Cleanup job added; watch metric registry.transient_tag.reclaimed_count and autosummarizer.queue_length. If reclaim > 500/hr or queue latency > 2m, scale cleanup worker or autosummary composer. Run `scripts/seed-example-with-affordance.sh` in staging to validate onboarding UX.
user_impact: Opt-in feature at intake; no changes for existing customers. Customers using intake templates can add transient tags to ease canary routing and internal cost tracking. Curators will see draft release notes under /internal/release-drafts.
migration_instructions: Run migrations/20260218_add_transient_tag.sql; ensure owner whitelist is populated in config (see docs). For on-prem/private installs, enable TTL worker via registry.service.ttl_cleanup.enabled=true and provide a Redis connection for index queues.
